Messages.Author: Oko
Messages.Body:
Yeah, deck is crazy.

It's god damn disgusting the amount of shenanigans you get to pull off.
Erlic into Nicomedes on rounds 2,3 and (maybe?? Can't recall. Much beer.) the finals gave me the head start I needed, what comes to hand tuning. Barrens allowed me to do some cycle+discard into a quick 7+Legionnaire into ash heap, and start going off if needed.

The ability to daisychain the legionnaires is really nice, it's like Khazar's but you actually get to go off. Giggidy.
What I *dont* consider very fair, is their ability to act on the turn they get recruited. That's pushing it.

As for the deck, apparently it's a bit of a mish-mash of cards that might be good. Felt a bit like it, too. The Spirits are kinda useless here, you end up straight up bleeding / recruiting something better nearly all the time. Stealth could use some adding, but it worked in this meta, so yay for me.
Disciple of Lazarus helped me get a playable crypt game 1, so good on that. Otherwise, it was a useless card.

I'm sure there's a few cards that'd be a welcome addition to this deck, but in general, more bleed, stealth and bounce is a good way to take it. I'd add some shenanigan cards too, Trochomancy seems to fit the bill with the amount of allies I saw over here, but it's more of a meta choice. Look at Lazarene Inquisitor there. It's trash, and it ain't good here, but there ARE games, where having that choice will win you the game. Otherwise, it doesn't suck when it gets Liquidated.

TLDR: Add stealth, bounce and bleed. Remove Vengeful Spirits. Lauri was nowhere near ousting me. cash me outside, howbow dah.
